intervals.method: Percentile bootstrap over clusters drawn with replacement; each metric is a ratio of sums recomputed on every resample, and a cluster keeps all its truth items, findings and repeats together. A cluster with nothing to count for a metric is left out of it. The interval describes this run and decides nothing: the trend's alarm and the acceptance rule compare two runs with a paired sign-flip test. With fewer than minClusters clusters it is null, listed under tooFewClusters.
intervals.seed: mulberry32 seeded with the first 32 bits of sha256 over the run id, the configuration and the metric name, joined by NUL

aacr.label: AACR-Bench's own evaluator on this run's findings: a board output and a diagnostic, never an acceptance metric. Line numbers come from its path, side and line stages; semantic numbers only from a judged evaluation the wrapper ran.
